The Venom skill involves the production of various venoms by glands. These glands are remnants of evolution and lay dormant in most people. To those with the skill though, they can be used to great effect. First, one must secrete a particular venom. There will be a short pause while your glands produce the chosen toxin. Once the venom has been secreted, it cannot be held in the bloodstream indefinitely. Each venom has a risk factor incorporated into it. The more powerful the venom, the greater the chance of it backfiring and affecting the producer. To get the venom out of the bloodstream, one must either bite another adventurer or purge the venom from their body.

It should be pointed out that denizens will be immune to most venoms that do things other than cause damage.

The skill of '''Venom''' is available to members of the [[Serpent]] [[class]], along with [[Subterfuge]] and [[Hypnosis]].

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Ekanelia
 |description=A lethality profound.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=EKANELIA<br>EKANELIA STUDY <reaction>
 |required=
 |target=
 |cooldown=
 |detail=Your grasp of venom has reached such a profound transcendence that you are now able to turn the very immune system of your victim's against
them. Certain venoms, when delivered in just the right quantities, can promote violent immune responses which in turn lead to cascading failures and further afflictions manifesting throughout the subjects body.<p>Each reaction has:<br>A trigger: the venom which sets off the cascading failure (this is what you bite with).<br>Conditionals: the afflictions which the subject must already labour under.<br>A result: the result of the reaction taking place.<p>Some reactions have:<br>A bonus conditional: a bonus conditional which can be met.<br>A bonus result: the bonus which is achieved if the bonus conditional is met.<p>Naturally, with the exact dose and balance requirements of this high art of venom, only the fangs of the serpent are sufficient for this purpose(*).<p>* You may see what reactions you are aware of with the EKANELIA command, and study one at further length with the EKANELIA STUDY <reaction> command.<br>** Reactions fire on the bite command.</p>
}}
